title: IVG Intense Salts Kiwi Passion Guava 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Kiwi Passion Guava brings together three exotic fruits for a tropical vape. Sharp Kiwi adds tang, Passionfruit delivers sweetness with depth, and mellow Guava rounds out the blend with a juicy finish. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt ensures clear flavour delivery, discreet vapour production, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Kiwi Passion Guava is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) pod kits, pens, and starter systems. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Kiwi Passion Guava captures both tartness and sweetness for those who enjoy tropical blends.
